summary: The comment from a teacher in Illinois urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting proposals to sunset or eliminate it, and emphasizes the essential role of reliable broadband in modern education. The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate to protect its funding and ensure access to connectivity for students and libraries.

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would increase costs for schools
claims.evidence_quote: Morton High School Dist 201 has received $1.38 million in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $275,351 a year toward the connections our students depend on
